description: Regency Centers Corporation is a fully integrated real estate company and self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust that began its operations as a publicly-traded REIT in 1993, with corporate headquarters at One Independent Drive, Suite 114, Jacksonville, Florida, and Regency Centers, L.P. is a subsidiary through which Regency Centers Corporation conducts substantially all of its operations and which owns, directly or indirectly, substantially all of its assets. Its business consists of acquiring, developing, owning and operating income-producing retail real estate principally located in suburban trade areas with compelling demographics within the United States, and it generates revenues by leasing space to necessity, service, convenience and value-based retailers serving the essential needs of its communities, and it has been an S&P 500 Index member since 2017, with full or partial equity ownership interests in 481 properties as of December 31, 2025, and it is among the largest owners of shopping centers in the USA based on revenues, number of properties, GLA and market capitalization.
